channel.title: Wire — Frontend
channel.description: Frontend from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Mobile View: Test Desktop and Mobile Layouts Side by Side
item.description: Mobile View places a real phone or tablet right on top of your desktop page, so you see the desktop and the mobile-adaptive layout on one screen, live. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Form-Saver: Web Component That Saves/Restores Form Values
item.description: A web component that stores (and restores) values within the form it wraps - aarongustafson/form-saver (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Svelte Bits: Animated UI Components for Svelte
item.description: An open source collection of high quality, animated, interactive & fully customizable Svelte components for building stunning, memorable user interfaces. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Dither: A Fine-Grained Vector Dithering Tool
item.description: Convert images and gradients into scalable vector dither patterns. Bayer, halftone, dots, lines, and more. Export as SVG or PNG. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Public Domain Image Archive: A Hand-Picked Collection of 11,000+ Out-of-Copyright Works
item.description: Explore our hand-picked collection of out-of-copyright works, free for all to browse, download, and reuse. This is a living database with new images added every week. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: type.lol: A Directory to Discover Typefaces from Independent Foundries
item.description: Discover and explore independent type foundries from around the world. Browse 1,100+ foundries, 14,000+ typefaces, and 1,600+ designers. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Podcast: Scott Jenson on Evolving Desktop OS, Local-First, & Agentic UX
item.description: In this episode, Scott Jenson, a veteran UX designer known for his work on the Macintosh, Google Maps, and Chrome examines the long-term stagnation of desktop operating systems and the limitations of current mobile and cloud-centric… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: Running AI at the Edge: Running Real Workloads Directly in the Browser
item.description: James Hall discusses the strategic and technical imperative of moving AI workloads from cloud providers to local edge devices. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Interview with oofoe about REBOL, Forth, Decker, Janet and the VFx Industry
item.description: Oofoe ( sourcehut ) is a REBOL-refugee comes from animation and now works on precision instrument software. (1 source: lobsters)
